definition_zh: 两党的；获两党共同支持的；超党派的
definition_en: involving or supported by two major political parties
core_image: 会议桌两侧的党派把手伸向同一份草案
scene: 听证会开了整整一周，两党代表罕见地站在同一侧。The bill passed with bipartisan support.
sceneCN: 这里 bipartisan 是「两党共同支持的」（第 1 个义项：由两大政党联合推动）；句意是该法案在两党共同支持下获得通过。

derivatives.zh: bipartisan 加 -ship，义为「两党合作；跨党派协作」
基础词，义为「党徒；党派性的」
non- 加 partisan，义为「无党派的；不偏党的」

senses.title: Supported by both major parties
senses.definition: backed by or agreed between the two main political parties
senses.definitionCN: 得到两大政党共同支持或由两党达成一致
senses.example: The bill passed with bipartisan support.
senses.exampleCN: 该法案在两党共同支持下获得通过。
senses.why: Bi- means two and partisan means party member; two parties stand together.
senses.whyCN: bi- 意为「二」，partisan 意为「党徒」，两党并肩即 bipartisan。

senses.title: Made by members of both parties
senses.titleCN: 由两党成员共同制定的
senses.definition: created or sponsored jointly by politicians of both parties
senses.definitionCN: 由两党政客联合发起或起草
senses.example: A bipartisan group drafted the compromise.
senses.exampleCN: 一个两党小组起草了这份折中案。
senses.why: Cooperation is measured by who holds the pen.

senses.title: Rising above party lines
senses.definition: showing willingness to set party interest aside
senses.definitionCN: 表现出把党派利益搁置一边的意愿
senses.example: Her bipartisan instincts surprised the whips.
senses.exampleCN: 她的超党派直觉让党鞭们吃惊。
senses.why: Two-party joining implies loosening party grip.
senses.whyCN: 两党联手意味着松开党派之手的掌控。

senses.title: Of commissions and bodies
senses.definition: describing panels composed of both parties in balance
senses.definitionCN: 指由两党成员均衡组成的委员会或机构
senses.example: A bipartisan commission reviewed the election rules.
senses.exampleCN: 一个两党委员会复核了选举规则。
senses.why: Balance of parties gives such bodies their authority.
senses.whyCN: 两党均势赋予此类机构权威。

senses.title: Of consensus policies
senses.definition: of policies resting on cross-party consensus
senses.definitionCN: 指建立在跨党派共识之上的政策
senses.example: Infrastructure has long been a bipartisan theme.
senses.exampleCN: 基建向来是跨党派议题。
senses.why: Some policies attract both parties by their nature.
senses.whyCN: 有些政策天然吸引两党。

senses.title: Contrasted with partisan
senses.definition: standing in opposition to one-party or strictly party conduct
senses.definitionCN: 与单方党派行为相对立
senses.example: The vote was bipartisan, not partisan.
senses.exampleCN: 这次表决是跨党派的，而非党派之争。
senses.why: The bi- prefix answers the charge of one-sidedness.
senses.whyCN: bi- 前缀正是对「偏党」之责的回应。

senses.title: Rhetoric of cooperation
senses.definition: describing language or gestures of cross-party goodwill
senses.definitionCN: 形容跨党派善意的话语或姿态
senses.example: His bipartisan tone softened the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 他的跨党派口吻缓和了听证会气氛。
senses.why: Tone, like votes, can be two-sided.
senses.whyCN: 语气与选票一样，可以两边都顾。

senses.title: Historic bipartisan eras
senses.titleCN: 历史上的两党合作时期
senses.definition: of periods when the two parties routinely cooperated
senses.definitionCN: 指两党惯于合作的年代
senses.example: Historians call that decade a bipartisan age.
senses.exampleCN: 史家称那十年为两党合作年代。
senses.why: Eras, like bills, can wear the two-party label.
senses.whyCN: 时代如法案，也可挂上两党标签。

intro.en: Bipartisan is bi-, two, plus partisan, a party adherent.
intro.cn: bipartisan 由 bi-「二」加 partisan「党徒」构成。

items.en: partigiano meant a partisan, an adherent, from parte, part.
items.cn: 意大利语 partigiano 意为「党徒、追随者」，源自 parte「部分」。

items.en: partisan passed into French as a military adherent, then a party man.
items.cn: partisan 进入法语，先指武装追随者，后指党人。

items.en: English took partisan as an adherent, later as a party loyalist.
items.cn: 英语借入 partisan，先指追随者，后指党派忠诚者。

items.en: bipartisan forms in the 19th century to describe cross-party action.
items.cn: 19 世纪出现 bipartisan，形容跨党派行动。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the partisan root; the near-meaning group gathers party-politics words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 partisan 词根；近义组汇集政党政治类词。

entries.definitionCN: 党徒；党派性的——bipartisan 的词基
跨党派的——英式常用表达

normalIntro.en: Bipartisan is bi- (two) plus partisan (party man).
normalIntro.cn: bipartisan 是 bi-（二）加 partisan（党徒）。

normal.en: Nonpartisan means free of party ties.
It is chiefly used in American politics.
normal.cn: 它主要用于美国政治语境。

abstract.en: See two elephants and one donkey sharing a desk.
abstract.cn: 看两头象与一头驴同桌议事。

abstract.en: Feel one pen signed by two hands.
abstract.cn: 感受一支笔被两只手先后握住。

abstract.en: Picture a red-blue ribbon tied in one knot.
abstract.cn: 想象红蓝两条丝带结成一个结。

examples.en: The bill passed with bipartisan support.
examples.cn: 该法案在两党共同支持下获得通过。

examples.en: A bipartisan group drafted the compromise.
examples.cn: 一个两党小组起草了这份折中案。

examples.en: A bipartisan commission reviewed the election rules.
examples.cn: 一个两党委员会复核了选举规则。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆·拍提赞」——两党议员在镜头前摆好姿势，互相拍肩提点赞成。

root: 意大利语 partigiano「党徒」（源自 parte「部分」，经法语 partisan 进入英语）加拉丁前缀 bi-「二」（上溯原始印欧语 dwo-，重构形式）；19 世纪美国政治语境中形成 bipartisan，指两大政党联手，派生 bipartisanship。

sensesIntro.en: Two parties standing together gives English its word for bills, committees, and eras of cooperation.
sensesIntro.cn: 「两党并肩」为英语提供了法案、委员会乃至合作时代的用词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two party banners covering one table
core.cn: 核心意象：两面团旗铺在同一张桌上

branches.en: Rising above party in deed and tone
branches.cn: 行动与语气上的超党派

branches.en: Contrast with partisanship and cooperative eras
branches.cn: 与党派之争相对及合作年代

intro.en: Bipartisan stacks a number prefix on a borrowed party word.
intro.cn: bipartisan 在借入的党派词上加数词前缀。

latinIntro.en: The bi- prefix with the partisan family.
latinIntro.cn: bi- 前缀与 partisan 词族。
